# File from OpenAI's repository

`lean/ComparatorChallenges/UniformFourier.lean` is an unmodified copy of the file at the same path in
github.com/openai/math at commit fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb (family 130, "Exact Fourier transforms
below n log n"; Apache-2.0). It is OpenAI's statement. It is here so that the modified copies in the packages
(the exponent and the names changed) can be compared with it; `VERIFY.md` says how.
